name: Kuo Yang Construction Co Ltd
summary: Kuo Yang Construction Co.,Ltd is primarily involved in constructing public residential developments across Taiwan. Beyond this, the firm actively deals in the acquisition, disposal, and letting of various commercial properties, including commercial housing units, industrial facilities, and general business premises. The company's activities further encompass strategic real estate investment, property creation, and property management services like rentals and leasing. Founded in 1961, Kuo Yang Construction Co.,Ltd maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
